claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Elite Eight is set for March 28–29.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Elite Eight determines the Final Four.
Saturday's games feature No. 3 Illinois vs. No. 9 Iowa.
Saturday's games feature No. 1 Arizona vs. No. 2 Purdue.
Sunday's matchups include No. 1 Michigan vs. No. 6 Tennessee.
Sunday's matchups include No. 2 UConn vs. No. 1 Duke
#3 Illinois vs. #9 Iowa is scheduled for Saturday, March 28 at 6:09 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV.
#1 Arizona vs. #2 Purdue is scheduled for Saturday, March 28 at 8:49 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV
#1 Michigan vs. #6 Tennessee is scheduled for Sunday, March 29 at 2:15 p.m. ET on CBS.
#2 UConn vs. #1 Duke is scheduled for Sunday, March 29 at 5:05 p.m. ET on CBS.
Arizona advanced to their first Final Four since 2001.
Arizona's freshmen had a 52-point combined performance.
No. 9 seed Iowa reached the Elite Eight under first-year coach Ben McCollum.
Saturday games are on TBS and truTV.
Games stream on March Madness Live App.
